PageId.description: A shared page's id: 16 random bytes the host picks, in unpadded base64url.

PageShare.description: A page the host shared. Its HTML is sealed with the key in the link, so the server cannot read it.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working, in Unix milliseconds.

views.description: How many times a viewer has opened the page.

PageShareState.description: A shared page as it stands, and whether the host stopped it.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops or stopped working, in Unix milliseconds.

ended.description: The host stopped sharing it. An expired page is not ended; its expiresAt is past.
